title: Response to Ariel and Hasid’s Letter
summary_en: This article defends the importance of studying LLMs for alcohol misuse support outside clinical settings, noting most affected individuals never engage with formal care and use digital tools independently.
title_cn: Response to Ariel and Hasid’s Letter

title: Verified Machine Learning Infrastructure: Formal Methods for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence Deployment
summary_en: The authors determine whether formal methods—using mathematical techniques to reason about software behavior and, potentially, show that systems behave as specified—could meaningfully secure the infrastructure on which artificial intelligence runs.
title_cn: Verified Machine Learning Infrastructure: Formal Methods for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence Deployment
